name: @youproof.org/newsletter-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker backing the youproof.org newsletter subscription API (double opt-in, Brevo integration, D1-backed state) served at youproof.org/api/v1/newsletter/*.

scripts.//deploy-order: On a real deploy (CONTENT_DIR available) run generate-buildinfo BEFORE build so the accepted privacy-policy content SHA is inlined; prebuild is a no-op so build/typecheck work without a content checkout (the committed buildinfo.json stub is valid).
scripts.//db: D1 schema is applied with wrangler (see docs/newsletter.md). Terraform creates the database; wrangler only applies migrations and runs local dev.
